message: Hi Jane, I'm really concerned about Emily's recent grades and her attitude at school. I've noticed she's been a bit withdrawn lately. Can you share any observations from class that might help me understand what's going on?
Hello Mrs. Thompson, I've received your message and will get back to you with my observations soon.
Good morning Jane, this is Anna Thompson, Emily's mother. I wanted to discuss Emily's performance and social interactions at school. Could we set up a time to talk?
Hey Ms. Doe, sorry about the disruption in class yesterday. I know it wasn't fair to the others. I am especially sorry for interrupting Emily and making her feel bad.
Thank you for your apology, Michael. Let's work on making the classroom a positive environment for everyone.
Reminder: Parent-teacher meetings are scheduled for next week. Please confirm your attendance.
Noted, I will be there. Thank you!
Faculty meeting at 3 PM in the main conference room.
Ms. Doe, I'm struggling with the new math topic. Can we go over it again next class?
